definitions.full: H8295. sarat [ שָׂרַט ] verb incise, scratch (Late Hebrew id. , so Aramaic סְרַט Pa ( ᵑ7 1Sam 21:14 ), , scratch , hence write (= χαράσσω ); Assyrian šarâ‰u , slit up, rend ; Arabic slit ear of camel, , sign, mark (RS K 214 f. ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural with accusative of congnate meaning with verb שָׂרָ֑טֶת יִשְׂרְטוּ לֹא וּבִבְשָׂרָם Lev 21:5 shall make no incision; Infinitive absolute with Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ שָׂרוֺט Zech 12:3 those loaded with the stone shall be severely scratched , lacerated.
